I set the next bug batch and committed it as 3c5ccd42. I didn't push it, although the task says to (reason below).

**Decision.** The driver stopped on b22's old report, not on a new failure. Run 1 of b22 stopped `partial` because K3b's files were not yet committed and broke the build. K3b is committed now (79e5571b). Run 1's fix is still uncommitted in `emit_core_leaves.nika` and its lowered copy. I moved the old report to `b22-1099-fstring-no-hole-braces.md.report.run1.md`. The b22 brief now tells the builder to take over those two files, test them and commit them. Committing them changes the self-hosted share, so the brief points it to the badge rule in `docs/builder-facts.md`. b29, b30, b31 and b32 are all done and committed locally.

**Batch** (`docs/briefs/bugs/batch.txt`), each a builder on opus, in this order:
1. `b22-1099-fstring-no-hole-braces.md`, run 2: a wrong value, the fix is already written, cheap.
2. `b33-1107-copy-view-copied.md`: a wrong refusal; ADR-387 already decides it.
3. `b21-1097-flat-map-seq-result.md`: a wrong refusal (NK1245), one function.

I re-ran the probes of b33 and b21 today and both still fail as their briefs say. All three issues already carry `wip`.

**Issues.** b30 found a separate defect. I reproduced it and filed it as #1132 (`ready`, in brief form, no bug brief yet). An or-pattern binding of a variant's text field, filled only from literals, lowers as `&'static str`, so pushing it into a `Vec[String]` fails in rustc. The suspected place is `bind_static_payloads` in `text_tiers.nika`, which has no arm for `Or`.

**Repository.** I rewrote the bug lane's part of the *State* section in `docs/architect.md` and wrote my report to `docs/briefs/bugs/architect-task.md.report.md`.

**Needs from the main session:** please push. `develop` is 4 commits ahead of `origin/develop`, and only one of them is mine; the others are builder commits from this lane, listed in `docs/briefs/bugs/unpushed.txt`. Pushing my commit would push them too before the driver has run the suite on them, so I left the push to the driver.

**Owner:** nothing to decide.
